newsitem.title: UK: UK's ITV has four million viewers for Grand Prix.
newsitem.headline: UK's ITV has four million viewers for Grand Prix.

text.p: The ITV commercial television network said on Monday that four million Britons had tuned in to watch Scotsman David Coulthard win the Australian Formula One Grand Prix this weekend.

ITV, screening its first Grand Prix, said an average of 3.2 million viewers watched the re-run of the race on Sunday afternoon, rising to 3.9 million towards the end. Some 870,000 people watched the race live in the small hours of Sunday.
In addition, 630,000 people watched the qualifying session live early on Saturday morning and two million tuned in for the lunchtime repeat.
"We're delighted with the performance of our first Grand Prix, both in terms of the professionalism of the television coverage and the viewing figures," said ITV network director Marcus Plantin.
ITV has paid an estimated 70 million pounds to secure a five-year deal for live coverage of Formula One racing. Formula One was previously broadcast by the BBC BBC.CN.
